description: This file defines the 'Context' class for managing page interactions, actions, history, and snapshots within the Playwright testing framework. It includes methods for running actions, handling request events, and managing secrets.

classes.name: Context
classes.description: Manages interactions with a Playwright page, including executing actions, maintaining history, handling request events, and taking snapshots.

methods.name: runActionAndWait
methods.description: Runs a single action and waits for its completion.

methods.name: runActionsAndWait
methods.description: Runs multiple actions and waits for their completion.

methods.name: runActionNoWait
methods.description: Runs a single action without waiting for its completion.

methods.name: actions
methods.description: Returns a copy of the list of actions executed.

methods.name: history
methods.description: Returns the history of 'expect' or 'perform' items.

methods.name: pushHistory
methods.description: Adds a new item to the history and clears current actions.

methods.name: consumeTokens
methods.description: Reduces the token budget by a specified amount.

methods.name: waitForCompletion
methods.description: Waits for page requests to complete and handles navigation and responses.

methods.name: takeSnapshot
methods.description: Takes a snapshot of the page for AI processing.

methods.name: snapshotResult
methods.description: Generates a result object with snapshot and error info.
